text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming the 3,000-meter trial, a
blistering
gale snatches victory from the
flower of famed
lineage and brings the
Triple Crown tour to a
splendid close!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Ines Fujin! Ines Fujin has triumphed!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Ines! That was some
incredible
racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I carry Ines Fujin to the waiting room.
She
undergoes a brief examination, but
the doctor
tells me she's perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh. I collapsed again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...This is pathetic. I've caused so much
trouble and
made everyone worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could pull it together. And
my sisters
were watching too... This
means I—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
N-no, nothing like that! It's just, you
know...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There was that whole mess before the
race, and
then I went and passed out, so
I... I'm just really
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay, though. I am. I won't mess up
ever
again! No matter what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin may insist that she's fine now,
but she
certainly doesn't look it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. Nothing happened at all.
I'm fine.
Totally fine...
choice_data_list: ...Ines, if something happened, talk to me.
...Ines, if something happened, please talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...!
B-but... it's like...
choice_data_list: I want to cherish what's precious to you.
I want to cherish what's precious to you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can't take care of the things that are
important
to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes well up like a dam about to
burst.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Last time I visited home... I found out
something
that shocked me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My sisters quit their dance lessons so
they could
help out around the house.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Our mom gets sick a lot. And she's been
going
through another bad spell lately,
so she's in and
out of hospital.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My sisters said they're going to take care
of her in
my place, since I can't be there
right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This is all because I left home to satisfy
my own
selfish desire to race...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Why did you two give up dancing?! I can
just quit
racing and come home. That
will solve everything!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
You're wrong! You don't get it, Big Sis!
Just go
back to the academy already!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
I won't forgive you if you quit racing to
stay at
home! I'll never talk to you again!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
This is something me and Polly set our
minds on!
If you go and quit racing now,
then...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Father
text_block_list.text: Sigh. We all discussed this, and we want you to pursue your dream. So there's no need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So... you two will be happy as long as I
don't give
up on running?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But you don't need to handle everything

yourselves. There are plenty of
housekeeping
services these days, and I
could pay for it with my
wages.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So please don't let go of your dreams...
Promise
me that one thing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I worked all I could to send more money home, but that just made them more worried that I'd end up ruining my health.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to put their minds at ease, to
show them
I wasn't overdoing it. I even
changed my running
style in an attempt
to blow away all their worries.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I didn't want them to see me
collapse
after the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If things keep going like this, then...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry! I guess it's not really that
big a deal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It is what it is, you know? Besides, I'm
sure girls
born into prestigious families
are under a lot more
pressure than I am.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It kind of feels like I should be doing all
this
bellyaching about race-related stuff,
huh? Like a
major injury or something.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for burdening you with
something so
trivial. It's a family matter,
so there's no need for
you to worry
about it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: It's an important issue to you, isn't it?
It's an important issue to you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...
choice_data_list: Don't carry it all by yourself. Let's think through it together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Waaaaah! Sob, sob...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tears that had been filling Ines
Fujin's eyes
finally begin to overflow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders tremble as she sobs. I
gently put my
arm around her in an offer
of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once she eventually calms down, we
talk about
what her next step should be.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The next step, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that might be a good idea.
choice_data_list: Why don't you take it easy for now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'd like that. A short one. Just until I
figure out
how to handle my situation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As for my next major goal... Would it be
all right
to choose something far off?
Say, early spring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is a G1 race held in
spring. At
2,000 meters on turf, the
distance shouldn't pose
an issue. It's
even held at Hanshin Racecourse,
just
like the Asahi Hai F.S.
choice_data_list: Then how about the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That sounds good. I think I can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Kikuka Sho, I make
a phone
call that I believe will be
important in supporting
Ines Fujin going
forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brrring, brrring...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hello, is this Ines's trainer? Thank you
for always
looking out for my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry we haven't had many
opportunities to
speak on the phone like
this. Are you calling
about the matter we
discussed previously?
choice_data_list: Likewise, thank you for all your support.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a request of my own. I
hesitate to
ask considering the situation,
but regarding the
Arima Kinen...
